metadata.case_name: MAK YUE v. CHAN SIU KAY

plaintiff.occupation_before: employed in a vegetable shop or market

injuries.description: fracture of the right upper arm
source: He suffered a fracture of the right upper arm, a dislocated left finger joint, and various lacerations. The arm fracture was treated by the insertion of 4 bone screws.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of hip or thigh

manifestations.description: marked limitation of shoulder movement / severe impairment of normal movement of the right arm
several scars of no cosmetic significance except for one large one on his right shoulder
post-traumatic neurosis / compensation neurosis (prominent emotional response with tendency to exaggerate; firmly believes he can never move his right arm freely again)

treatments_received: Insertion of 4 bone screws (for right upper arm fracture)
Manipulation of the right shoulder joint under general anaesthesia (25/7/78)
Removal of the bone screws (operation in August 1979)
treatments_future: psychiatric management (recommended for about 18 months) - Dr. Pang

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (award for general damages)
Weakened shoulder joint with limited mobility / marked limitation of shoulder movement
One large scar on his right shoulder
Slightly weakened leg resulting in a slight limp
